pages.heading: Visits
pages.text: Cedar Observatory public tours start at 19:30. Tour admission costs 12 credits. Reservations close on Thursday.

pages.heading: Equipment
pages.text: The primary telescope aperture is 240 millimetres. The telescope custodian is Mira Chen. Calibration occurs every Tuesday.

pages.heading: Weather
pages.text: Tours are cancelled when wind speed exceeds 35 kilometres per hour. Cancelled reservations receive refunds within five business days.

pages.heading: Fleet
pages.text: The Juniper fleet contains 48 bicycles. All fleet bicycles use 26 inch wheels. The maintenance manager is Omar Vale.

pages.heading: Maintenance
pages.text: Bicycle tyre pressure should be 55 PSI. Chains are lubricated every 150 kilometres. Brake inspections occur every Friday.

pages.heading: Checkout
pages.text: Bicycles may be borrowed for a maximum of four hours. The return station closes at 18:00. The replacement deposit is 80 credits.

pages.heading: Opening
pages.text: Willow Library opens at 09:15 on weekdays. The library closes at 17:45. The service coordinator is Elena Moss.

pages.heading: Loans
pages.text: Members may borrow seven books at a time. The standard loan period is 21 days. Overdue charges are two credits per day.

pages.heading: Study rooms
pages.text: Study room reservations last 90 minutes. Rooms accommodate six people. Reservations must be made at least two hours ahead.
